exercises.question: Which sentence says what you usually do, using soler?
options: Suelo caminar después de cenar. [I usually walk after dinner.]
Caminé después de cenar durante las vacaciones. [I walked after dinner during the holidays.]
Caminaré después de cenar la próxima semana. [I will walk after dinner next week.]

exercises.sentence: Suelo __ después de cenar porque me ayuda a dormir.
exercises.english: I usually walk after dinner because it helps me sleep.
At weekends we usually cook at home.

sentences: Normalmente preparo la cena en casa. [I normally prepare dinner at home.]
Después de cenar, suelo caminar. [After dinner, I usually walk.]
Así duermo mejor por la noche. [That way I sleep better at night.]

exercises.question: Which sentence uses soler correctly with nosotros?
options: Solemos cocinar en casa. [We usually cook at home.]
Solimos cocinar en casa. [We usually cook at home.]
Suelen cocinar en casa. [They usually cook at home.]

exercises.sentence: Mis padres __ cenar a las ocho.
exercises.english: My parents usually have dinner at eight.

exercises.sentence: Los fines de semana solemos cocinar en casa.
options: At weekends we usually cook at home.

At weekends we are going to eat in a restaurant.

exercises.sentence: Normalmente duermo siete horas, aunque durante los viajes duermo menos.
exercises.english: I normally sleep seven hours, although I sleep less when travelling.

template.prompt: Say that you usually walk after dinner because it helps you sleep better.
template.answer: Suelo caminar después de cenar porque me ayuda a dormir mejor.

template.prompt: Say that you want to change the habit of sleeping little because it can be harmful to your health.
template.answer: Quiero cambiar el hábito de dormir poco porque puede ser perjudicial para mi salud.
